name: Vietnamese Bánh Mì-Style Steak Sandwich with Pickled Veggie Salad (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 jalapeño pepper
½ English cucumber
½ lime
½ head butter (Boston) lettuce
½ (6 oz) pkg blueberries

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl, then stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
rice vinegar
2 tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and cut cucumber into thin matchsticks. Add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Place a 2/3-cup of grated carrot on a plate and set aside for later use. Add remaining carrot to the bowl, stir to combine the pickled veggies, and set aside.
Place mayo, vinegar, sugar, poppy seeds, and spices in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp rice vinegar
½ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp poppy seeds
garlic powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add reserved grated carrot to the bowl with the dressing, along with raisins, and stir to combine the carrot salad. Set aside. (Reserve plate for the next step.)
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Place on the reserved plate and set aside.
Zest lime into another small bowl. Add mayo and chili-garlic sauce, then stir to combine the spicy mayo. Set aside. (Reserve lime for the next step.)
Juice lime into a third small bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lime juice, along with fish sauce, maple syrup, garlic powder, and pepper, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ shallot
2 tsp fish sauce
1 tsp pure maple syrup
¼ tsp garlic powder
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels, place on a cutting board, and slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb striploin (New York strip) steak
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and stir-fry until just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove a ½-cup of steak strips and set aside. Add sauce to the skillet with the remaining steak strips. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant and sauce is reduced, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide carrot salad, plain steak strips, blueberries, and rice cakes between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide buns between plates, spread the bottom half of each bun with spicy mayo, then top with saucy steak strips and a small handful of pickled veggies. Close with the top half of each bun. Add lettuce to the plates, top with remaining pickled veggies (and some of the pickling liquid), and drizzle with oil. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mini rice cake
neutral vegetable oil
